examples.hanzi: 你放心去吧,家里的事我会处理好,你安心工作。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn qù ba, jiālǐ de shì wǒ huì chǔlǐ hǎo, nǐ ānxīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Don't worry, go ahead; I'll take care of things at home, so you can work with peace of mind.

examples.hanzi: 吃了药以后,他才能安心睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Chīle yào yǐhòu, tā cái néng ānxīn shuìjiào.
examples.english: Only after taking the medicine could he sleep peacefully.

examples.hanzi: 下雨时,有人在这条河里被淹死了,我们要注意安全。
examples.pinyin: Xiàyǔ shí, yǒu rén zài zhè tiáo hé lǐ bèi yānsǐ le, wǒmen yào zhùyì ānquán.
examples.english: Someone drowned in this river during the rain, so we must be careful.

examples.hanzi: 小心点,别让花被你浇水淹死了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn diǎn, bié ràng huā bèi nǐ jiāoshuǐ yānsǐ le.
examples.english: Careful, don't drown the flowers by overwatering them.

examples.hanzi: 这份工作的福利不错,有五险一金。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de fúlì búcuò, yǒu wǔxiǎn yì jīn.
examples.english: This job has good benefits, including social insurance and a housing fund.

examples.hanzi: 政府要提高老人的福利。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yào tígāo lǎorén de fúlì.
examples.english: The government wants to improve welfare for the elderly.

examples.hanzi: 周末我们去看赛车比赛。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen qù kàn sàichē bǐsài.
examples.english: This weekend we're going to watch a car race.

examples.hanzi: 他从小就爱玩赛车游戏。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù ài wán sàichē yóuxì.
examples.english: He has loved playing racing games since he was little.

examples.hanzi: 他出狱以后,找了一份新工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā chūyù yǐhòu, zhǎole yí fèn xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: After being released from prison, he found a new job.

examples.hanzi: 妻子一直在等他出狱,重新开始生活。
examples.pinyin: Qīzi yìzhí zài děng tā chūyù, chóngxīn kāishǐ shēnghuó.
examples.english: His wife has been waiting for him to be released so they can start life over.

examples.hanzi: 这座古城里藏着很多宝藏。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng lǐ cángzhe hěn duō bǎozàng.
examples.english: Many treasures are hidden in this ancient city.

examples.hanzi: 对我来说,图书馆就是一个宝藏。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, túshūguǎn jiù shì yí gè bǎozàng.
examples.english: To me, the library is a treasure trove.

examples.hanzi: 农民把畜生都赶回了圈里。
examples.pinyin: Nóngmín bǎ chùshēng dōu gǎnhuíle quān lǐ.
examples.english: The farmer drove all the livestock back into the pen.

examples.hanzi: 古时候,人们靠畜生耕地。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ shíhou, rénmen kào chùshēng gēngdì.
examples.english: In ancient times, people relied on farm animals to plow the land.

examples.hanzi: 这次旅行花费了我们不少钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng huāfèile wǒmen bù shǎo qián.
examples.english: This trip cost us quite a lot of money.

examples.hanzi: 我不想花费太多时间在路上。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng huāfèi tài duō shíjiān zài lùshang.
examples.english: I don't want to spend too much time on the road.

examples.hanzi: 卡特先生是我们的新邻居。
examples.pinyin: Kǎtè xiānsheng shì wǒmen de xīn línjū.
examples.english: Mr. Carter is our new neighbor.

examples.hanzi: 我的同事卡特每天骑车上班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngshì Kǎtè měitiān qí chē shàngbān.
examples.english: My colleague Carter cycles to work every day.

examples.hanzi: 公司要求所有员工参加预防性骚扰的培训。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqiú suǒyǒu yuángōng cānjiā yùfáng xìng sāorǎo de péixùn.
examples.english: The company requires all employees to attend training on preventing sexual harassment.

examples.hanzi: 性骚扰是违法的,受害者可以报警。
examples.pinyin: Xìng sāorǎo shì wéifǎ de, shòuhàizhě kěyǐ bàojǐng.
examples.english: Sexual harassment is illegal, and victims can call the police.

examples.hanzi: 这件事牵扯到很多人,不好处理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì qiānchě dào hěn duō rén, bù hǎo chǔlǐ.
examples.english: This matter involves many people and is hard to handle.

examples.hanzi: 我不想被牵扯进他们的家庭矛盾。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng bèi qiānchě jìn tāmen de jiātíng máodùn.
examples.english: I don't want to get dragged into their family conflict.

examples.hanzi: 博物馆里有一座古希腊的雕像。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ yǒu yí zuò gǔ Xīlà de diāoxiàng.
examples.english: The museum has an ancient Greek statue.

examples.hanzi: 这座雕像是用石头刻成的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò diāoxiàng shì yòng shítou kè chéng de.
examples.english: This statue was carved from stone.

examples.hanzi: 我为什么会来中国?说来话长。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wèishénme huì lái Zhōngguó? Shuōlái huà cháng.
examples.english: Why did I come to China? It's a long story.

examples.hanzi: 这件事说来话长,等吃完饭我再告诉你。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shuōlái huà cháng, děng chīwán fàn wǒ zài gàosu nǐ.
examples.english: It's a long story; I'll tell you after dinner.

examples.hanzi: 今晚我没空,下次一起吃饭吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīnwǎn wǒ méi kòng, xià cì yìqǐ chīfàn ba.
examples.english: I'm not free tonight; let's have dinner together next time.

examples.hanzi: 他最近太忙,连吃饭都没空。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn tài máng, lián chīfàn dōu méi kòng.
examples.english: He's so busy lately that he doesn't even have time to eat.

examples.hanzi: 他们因为钱的事发生了争执。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yīnwèi qián de shì fāshēngle zhēngzhí.
examples.english: They had a dispute over money.

examples.hanzi: 别为这点小事争执,伤了感情。
examples.pinyin: Bié wèi zhè diǎn xiǎoshì zhēngzhí, shāngle gǎnqíng.
examples.english: Don't argue over such a small thing and hurt your relationship.

examples.hanzi: 血液在身体里循环。
examples.pinyin: Xuèyè zài shēntǐ lǐ xúnhuán.
examples.english: Blood circulates in the body.

examples.hanzi: 这首歌我一直单曲循环,听了一整天。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē wǒ yìzhí dānqǔ xúnhuán, tīngle yì zhěngtiān.
examples.english: I've had this song on repeat all day.

examples.hanzi: 我一早起来就去跑步了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzǎo qǐlái jiù qù pǎobù le.
examples.english: I got up early in the morning and went running.

examples.hanzi: 明天一早我们就要出发。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yìzǎo wǒmen jiù yào chūfā.
examples.english: We have to set off first thing tomorrow morning.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们喜欢探索新的地方。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen xǐhuan tànsuǒ xīn de dìfang.
examples.english: Children like to explore new places.

examples.hanzi: 他一生都在探索如何让人们生活得更好。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìshēng dōu zài tànsuǒ rúhé ràng rénmen shēnghuó de gèng hǎo.
examples.english: He spent his life exploring how to make people's lives better.

examples.hanzi: 我一喊停,你们就停手,不要再吵了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì hǎn tíng, nǐmen jiù tíngshǒu, bú yào zài chǎo le.
examples.english: When I call stop, you stop; no more arguing.

examples.hanzi: 他一再劝我,我才停手不干了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yízài quàn wǒ, wǒ cái tíngshǒu bú gàn le.
examples.english: He kept urging me, and only then did I stop doing it.

examples.hanzi: 因为违反了规定,他被驱逐出境。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi wéifǎnle guīdìng, tā bèi qūzhú chūjìng.
examples.english: He was deported for violating the rules.

examples.hanzi: 老师把捣乱的同学驱逐出了教室。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ dǎoluàn de tóngxué qūzhú chūle jiàoshì.
examples.english: The teacher kicked the disruptive student out of the classroom.

examples.hanzi: 奶奶住在三楼的病房,我每天去看她。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai zhù zài sān lóu de bìngfáng, wǒ měitiān qù kàn tā.
examples.english: Grandma is in a ward on the third floor, and I visit her every day.

examples.hanzi: 病房里很安静,病人都在休息。
examples.pinyin: Bìngfáng lǐ hěn ānjìng, bìngrén dōu zài xiūxi.
examples.english: It's quiet in the ward, and the patients are all resting.

examples.hanzi: 冬天我喜欢穿一件长长的黑色大衣。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān wǒ xǐhuan chuān yí jiàn chángcháng de hēisè dàyī.
examples.english: In winter I like to wear a long black overcoat.

examples.hanzi: 这件大衣有点薄,不够暖和。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn dàyī yǒudiǎn báo, bú gòu nuǎnhuo.
examples.english: This coat is a bit thin and isn't warm enough.

examples.hanzi: 我已经付给他两百块钱了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng fùgěi tā liǎng bǎi kuài qián le.
examples.english: I've already paid him two hundred yuan.

examples.hanzi: 这笔钱应该付给谁?
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián yīnggāi fùgěi shéi?
examples.english: Who should this money be paid to?

examples.hanzi: 目前的局势很紧张,大家都很担心。
examples.pinyin: Mùqián de júshì hěn jǐnzhāng, dàjiā dōu hěn dānxīn.
examples.english: The current situation is tense, and everyone is worried.

examples.hanzi: 比赛的局势一下子变了,我们领先了。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài de júshì yíxiàzi biàn le, wǒmen lǐngxiān le.
examples.english: The situation in the game suddenly changed and we took the lead.

examples.hanzi: 这位老军士教过很多新兵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo jūnshì jiàoguo hěn duō xīnbīng.
examples.english: This veteran sergeant has trained many recruits.

examples.hanzi: 军士长命令大家集合。
examples.pinyin: Jūnshìzhǎng mìnglìng dàjiā jíhé.
examples.english: The sergeant major ordered everyone to assemble.

examples.hanzi: 吃水果以前,先用清水清洗一下。
examples.pinyin: Chī shuǐguǒ yǐqián, xiān yòng qīngshuǐ qīngxǐ yíxià.
examples.english: Before eating fruit, rinse it with clean water first.

examples.hanzi: 他每个周末都清洗自己的汽车。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi gè zhōumò dōu qīngxǐ zìjǐ de qìchē.
examples.english: He washes his car every weekend.

examples.hanzi: 我妈妈是一位家庭主妇,每天忙着做家务。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma shì yí wèi jiātíng zhǔfù, měitiān mángzhe zuò jiāwù.
examples.english: My mom is a housewife and is busy with housework every day.

examples.hanzi: 这位主妇每天都去菜市场买菜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhǔfù měitiān dōu qù càishìchǎng mǎi cài.
examples.english: This housewife goes to the market to buy groceries every day.

examples.hanzi: 他在一家大公司负责财务。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yì jiā dà gōngsī fùzé cáiwù.
examples.english: He is in charge of finance at a large company.

examples.hanzi: 公司的财务状况越来越好。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de cáiwù zhuàngkuàng yuè lái yuè hǎo.
examples.english: The company's financial situation is getting better and better.

examples.hanzi: 我们先看看菜单,再决定点什么。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān kànkan càidān, zài juédìng diǎn shénme.
examples.english: Let's look at the menu first and then decide what to order.

examples.hanzi: 这家餐厅的菜单是中英文的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de càidān shì Zhōng-Yīngwén de.
examples.english: This restaurant's menu is in both Chinese and English.

examples.hanzi: 他们公司的主要业务是出口茶叶。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen gōngsī de zhǔyào yèwù shì chūkǒu cháyè.
examples.english: Their company's main business is exporting tea.

examples.hanzi: 他刚来,对业务还不太熟悉。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng lái, duì yèwù hái bú tài shúxī.
examples.english: He just arrived and isn't very familiar with the work yet.

examples.hanzi: 同学们都叫他怪胎,因为他的想法很特别。
examples.pinyin: Tóngxuémen dōu jiào tā guàitāi, yīnwèi tā de xiǎngfǎ hěn tèbié.
examples.english: His classmates call him a weirdo because his ideas are unusual.

examples.hanzi: 在这个小镇上,大家都觉得他是个怪胎。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège xiǎozhèn shàng, dàjiā dōu juéde tā shì gè guàitāi.
examples.english: In this small town, everyone thinks he's a freak.

examples.hanzi: 请你按顺序排队,不要插队。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ àn shùnxù páiduì, bú yào chāduì.
examples.english: Please line up in order and don't cut in line.

examples.hanzi: 这几个步骤的顺序不能弄错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ gè bùzhòu de shùnxù bù néng nòng cuò.
examples.english: The order of these steps can't be mixed up.

examples.hanzi: 我喜欢在水里放几片柠檬。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zài shuǐ lǐ fàng jǐ piàn níngméng.
examples.english: I like to put a few slices of lemon in my water.

examples.hanzi: 这杯柠檬汁太酸了,我想加点糖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bēi níngméng zhī tài suān le, wǒ xiǎng jiā diǎn táng.
examples.english: This lemon juice is too sour, so I'd like to add some sugar.

examples.hanzi: 我们应该先解决自身的问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi xiān jiějué zìshēn de wèntí.
examples.english: We should first solve our own problems.

examples.hanzi: 这件事与他自身的努力分不开。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yǔ tā zìshēn de nǔlì fēn bù kāi.
examples.english: This has everything to do with his own effort.

examples.hanzi: 我们坐船穿过了这条深深的峡谷。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò chuán chuānguòle zhè tiáo shēnshēn de xiágǔ.
examples.english: We took a boat through this deep canyon.

examples.hanzi: 峡谷两边都是高高的岩石。
examples.pinyin: Xiágǔ liǎngbiān dōu shì gāogāo de yánshí.
examples.english: Both sides of the canyon are tall rock walls.

examples.hanzi: 运动不但锻炼肉体,也能放松心情。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng búdàn duànliàn ròutǐ, yě néng fàngsōng xīnqíng.
examples.english: Exercise trains the body and also relaxes the mind.

examples.hanzi: 人的肉体会老,但精神可以一直年轻。
examples.pinyin: Rén de ròutǐ huì lǎo, dàn jīngshén kěyǐ yìzhí niánqīng.
examples.english: The body ages, but the spirit can stay young.

examples.hanzi: 这台机器已经连续运行了一整天。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì yǐjīng liánxù yùnxíngle yì zhěngtiān.
examples.english: This machine has been running continuously for a whole day.

examples.hanzi: 电脑运行得太慢,我想重启一下。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo yùnxíng de tài màn, wǒ xiǎng chóngqǐ yíxià.
examples.english: The computer is running too slowly, so I want to restart it.

examples.hanzi: 这批水果用火车运输,三天后到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè pī shuǐguǒ yòng huǒchē yùnshū, sān tiān hòu dào.
examples.english: This batch of fruit is shipped by train and arrives in three days.

examples.hanzi: 他在一家运输公司当司机。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yì jiā yùnshū gōngsī dāng sījī.
examples.english: He works as a driver at a transport company.

examples.hanzi: 他貌似很高兴,其实心里很难过。
examples.pinyin: Tā màosì hěn gāoxìng, qíshí xīnlǐ hěn nánguò.
examples.english: He seems happy, but in fact he feels sad.

examples.hanzi: 这个人貌似我以前见过。
examples.pinyin: Zhège rén màosì wǒ yǐqián jiànguo.
examples.english: This person looks like someone I've met before.

examples.hanzi: 我小时候梦见自己会飞,太有意思了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou mèngjiàn zìjǐ huì fēi, tài yǒu yìsi le.
examples.english: When I was little I dreamed I could fly, which was so fun.

examples.hanzi: 昨天我梦见了已经去世的爷爷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ mèngjiànle yǐjīng qùshì de yéye.
examples.english: Yesterday I dreamed about my late grandfather.

examples.hanzi: 由于下雨,活动被迫终止了。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú xiàyǔ, huódòng bèi pò zhōngzhǐ le.
examples.english: Because of the rain, the event had to be called off.

examples.hanzi: 如果对方违约,你可以终止合同。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ duìfāng wéiyuē, nǐ kěyǐ zhōngzhǐ hétong.
examples.english: If the other party breaks the contract, you can terminate it.

examples.hanzi: 这孩子的模样很像他爸爸。
examples.pinyin: Zhè háizi de móyàng hěn xiàng tā bàba.
examples.english: This child looks a lot like his dad.

examples.hanzi: 他装出一副可怜的模样,想骗我给他买玩具。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhuāngchū yí fù kělián de móyàng, xiǎng piàn wǒ gěi tā mǎi wánjù.
examples.english: He put on a pitiful look, hoping to trick me into buying him a toy.

examples.hanzi: 我一般晚上上网看新闻。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìbān wǎnshang shàngwǎng kàn xīnwén.
examples.english: I usually go online to read the news in the evening.

examples.hanzi: 这里可以免费上网吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ kěyǐ miǎnfèi shàngwǎng ma?
examples.english: Can I get online here for free?

examples.hanzi: 我老家在北方,冬天特别冷。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lǎojiā zài běifāng, dōngtiān tèbié lěng.
examples.english: My hometown is in the north, and winters are especially cold.

examples.hanzi: 北方人爱吃饺子和面条。
examples.pinyin: Běifāng rén ài chī jiǎozi hé miàntiáo.
examples.english: Northerners love eating dumplings and noodles.

examples.hanzi: 他们在庆祝会上喝了几杯葡萄酒。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài qìngzhùhuì shàng hēle jǐ bēi pútáojiǔ.
examples.english: They had a few glasses of wine at the celebration.

examples.hanzi: 这瓶葡萄酒是用法国的葡萄酿的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè píng pútáojiǔ shì yòng Fǎguó de pútáo niàng de.
examples.english: This bottle of wine is made from French grapes.

examples.hanzi: 学校正在制定新的作息时间表。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhèngzài zhìdìng xīn de zuòxī shíjiānbiǎo.
examples.english: The school is drawing up a new daily schedule.

examples.hanzi: 我给自己制定了一个学习计划。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi zìjǐ zhìdìngle yí gè xuéxí jìhuà.
examples.english: I made myself a study plan.

examples.hanzi: 他听到了枪声,马上趴在了地上。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngdàole qiāngshēng, mǎshàng pā zàile dìshang.
examples.english: He heard a gunshot and immediately dropped to the ground.

examples.hanzi: 电影里传来一阵枪声,大家都很紧张。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ chuánlái yí zhèn qiāngshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: A burst of gunfire came from the movie, and everyone tensed up.

examples.hanzi: 这位青年每天坚持学习外语。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi qīngnián měitiān jiānchí xuéxí wàiyǔ.
examples.english: This young man keeps studying foreign languages every day.

examples.hanzi: 青年人应该多读书、多运动。
examples.pinyin: Qīngniánrén yīnggāi duō dúshū, duō yùndòng.
examples.english: Young people should read more and exercise more.

examples.hanzi: 做人要正直,不能说谎。
examples.pinyin: Zuòrén yào zhèngzhí, bù néng shuōhuǎng.
examples.english: You should be honest and not lie.

examples.hanzi: 他是个正直的警察,从不收礼。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè zhèngzhí de jǐngchá, cóng bù shōu lǐ.
examples.english: He's an upright police officer who never accepts gifts.

examples.hanzi: 上课要专注,不要看手机。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè yào zhuānzhù, bú yào kàn shǒujī.
examples.english: Concentrate in class and don't look at your phone.

examples.hanzi: 孩子专注地看着小鱼在水里游来游去。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zhuānzhù de kànzhe xiǎoyú zài shuǐ lǐ yóu lái yóu qù.
examples.english: The child watched the little fish swimming around, completely absorbed.
